description: Gatus is a status/uptime page and health-check tool — define endpoints and conditions in a config file and get a public-facing status page plus alerting (Slack, Discord, PagerDuty, and more). Complements the Uptime Kuma template in this list, which is geared more toward internal monitoring than a shareable status page.
name: gatus
note: You must create a config.yaml in the mounted config volume defining your endpoints before Gatus has anything to monitor — see the official documentation for the config format.
title: Gatus
